title: Sync custom background across devices with per-device override
description:
Today the custom uploaded background image is written only to localStorage (SettingsPanel.js resizeToDataUrl -> localStorage 'meridian_bg_custom'; read back in applyBackground for bg.type === 'custom'), while every other appearance setting goes to chrome.storage.sync. Result: background.type syncs across devices but the image bytes do not, so a synced device shows an empty/broken custom background.

Add opt-in sync with a per-device override, exposed in Settings:
- A "Use synced background" toggle — when on, the device pulls the shared synced background; when off, this device keeps its own local background regardless of what is synced.
- A "Sync current background" action — pushes THIS device's current custom background up so other devices can adopt it.

Implementation notes:
- chrome.storage.sync has an ~8KB per-item and ~100KB total quota, so a full-res data URL will NOT fit. Downscale/compress hard for the synced copy (small WebP, e.g. <=1280px, low quality) or store a reference/URL rather than raw bytes; keep the full-res image local for the device that owns it.
- Preserve current behavior as the default (local, unsynced) so existing users are unaffected.
- Define precedence clearly: per-device "Use synced background" off must win over a synced value.
Acceptance: toggling and pushing behave per the two controls above; no quota errors; devices with sync off are untouched.
label: Feature

activity.content:
Implemented opt-in custom background sync with a device-local override.

- Added a device-only `Use synced background` preference in `chrome.storage.local`, defaulting off so existing devices continue using their local full-resolution image.
- Added `Sync current background`, which creates an aggressively compressed WebP and iteratively keeps it below a 7,000-character payload budget before writing it to `chrome.storage.sync`.
- Kept the original full-resolution upload in local storage.
- Applied appearance updates when either the shared image or local override changes; an off override always resolves to the device-local image.
- Added tests for quota-bounded compression and local/synced precedence.

Validation: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` (8 passing), JavaScript syntax checks, and `git diff --check`.
